story.soThat: I know how much validation work remains

tasks.task: Implement ValidationProgress dataclass (AC: #1) Create dataclass in rustybt/validation/reporting.py Define strategy_completion, layer_completion, finding_resolution fields Define overall field for weighted average Add percentage formatting methods Test: Unit tests for dataclass

Implement calculate_completion function (AC: #1) Count validated vs total strategies (defined in PRD as 4) Count completed layers per strategy (5 layers * 4 strategies = 20) Count resolved vs total findings Calculate weighted average for overall score Test: Verify calculations with various states

Implement progress display (AC: #2) Create ASCII progress bars for each category Show fraction format (e.g., 3/4, 18/20) List completed and in-progress strategies Show missing layers for incomplete strategies Test: Verify display formatting

Implement next steps suggestions (AC: #2) Identify incomplete strategies and missing layers Generate numbered action items Prioritize by impact (complete strategies first) Include "Generate final report" when all complete Test: Verify next steps logic

Add CLI progress command (AC: #2) Add progress command to CLI main group Call calculate_completion for current state Display formatted progress with bars Display next steps suggestions Test: CLI integration tests
Write comprehensive tests (AC: #1-2) Test with 0% completion (no sessions) Test with partial completion Test with 100% completion Test next steps generation

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given defined validation scope When completion tracking is queried Then ValidationProgress is calculated with strategy_completion, layer_completion, finding_resolution, and weighted overall percentage
CLI command rustybt-validate progress displays progress bars for Strategies, Layers, Findings, Overall with percentage and fraction format, plus Next Steps suggestions with numbered actions
